newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish NTMA says won't hold Q4 20-yr bond auction.
newsitem.headline: Irish NTMA says won't hold Q4 20-yr bond auction.

text.p: Ireland's National Treasury Management Agency (NTMA) said on Wednesday it would not hold an auction of the 8.25 percent treasury bond due 2015 in the fourth quarter of 1996.
The NTMA had been due to hold an auction of the 20-year bond this quarter.
Analysts said the NTMA's funding position was comfortable and there was no need for it to hold an auction this quarter.
